assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:erwin-marcel@original-light-novels#86-marcel-character-reference-profile, the canonical Erwin Marcel character reference profile (CMR-6 scaled profile, version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels, in which he is materially attested from V02 to V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 and the perfume-battle material excluded. Row counts come only from the profile's own diagnostic scene bank (198 rows). The CMR-3 locator index, the CMR-9 promotion audit and ledger, the relationship matrix, the ledgers L01, L02 and L09, the numbered thematic Documents, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. V03 is split at the hospital scene (p-005 ¶192) and the recognition of the scapegoating mechanism (¶258); V05 at the apology (p-004 ¶318) and the command-post strike (p-006 ¶474); V11 at the address shift to レーナ (p-018 ¶361) and the reversed grief scene (p-026 ¶544-557); V12 at the self-standard (p-006 ¶393-402); and V14 at the adapted gunner role (p-008 ¶58). assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a causal account of Marcel (Erwin Marcel): a rough-spoken, emotionally legible Federacy officer whose central movement is from displaced to owned responsibility, without becoming serene, polished, physically restored or infallible. It states the mechanism and its interrupt: an intolerable, unrepairable loss makes him search for an agent who could have acted, responsibility expands beyond evidence and blame reduces helplessness (V02 p-004 ¶373; V03 p-005 ¶258-263); the mature interrupt is whether he is making someone else carry what he cannot (V05 p-004 ¶318; V12 p-006 ¶393-402). It says what changes his response: grief and anger narrow causal judgment; visible fear does not cancel action under immediate danger (V05 p-006 ¶474-482); embarrassment produces averted eyes and noise while he stays present; known technical questions get direct answers and unknown ones an admission (V12 p-006 ¶354). It predicts his mistakes: the racialized accusation against Shin (Shinei Nouzen) and the way he told Nina (Nina Rantz), the sister of his dead friend Eugene (Eugene Rantz), how Eugene died, tactlessness, and fear made visible. A would overclaim: the set is one derived profile that defers to the L01, L02 and L09 ledgers outside it, the profile's own open question (whether owned responsibility survives another loss on the scale of Eugene's death) is untested, and the mentoring extrapolation is only moderate. C would understate an account that says which consideration decides in each sampled class and how the decisive interrupt changed between V02 and V12.

Ten ordered states of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) with causes and located turns: V02 blame story and rebuke (p-004 ¶373-384); V03 hospital, the right-leg fracture and recognition of the scapegoating mechanism while still inside it (p-005 ¶192, ¶258-263); V05 apology without self-exoneration (p-004 ¶318) and fear with competence (p-005 ¶404; p-006 ¶474-482); V06-V09 professional reintegration as control officer and fixed-fire support (V06 p-007 ¶80) and ordinary friendship (V07 p-007 ¶448-465); V11 reversal of the V02 structure when Shin (Shinei Nouzen) brings him a dangerous feeling (p-026 ¶538-557) and low-formality staff trust with Lena (Vladilena Milizé) (p-018 ¶359-370); V12 responsibility as a general self-standard (p-006 ¶390-402); V14 adapted combat as gunner, return without restoration (p-008 ¶58-289). The counterexample audit forbids regressions (permanently hostile, permanently penitent, healed leg). C would understate located, causally ordered transitions with these controls. A is rejected: V10 has no row, V04 and V06 have three and four rows, V06-V09 is one grouped phase, and nothing after V14 is established.

The profile fixes the written-Japanese register of Marcel (Erwin Marcel): relaxed first person 俺 (relaxed 僕 or 私 would sound wrong), contractions and colloquial reductions as baseline in grief, politics and technical talk alike (つーか, わかんねえ, 食ってけねえ, じゃねえ, やりきれねえ), flexible upward politeness with 〜っす toward less familiar or senior listeners (V09 p-006 ¶190-194), surname address ノウゼン for Shin (Shinei Nouzen) even after repair, a located shift from 大佐 (V05 p-006 ¶241) to レーナ in work talk (V11 p-018 ¶361), hesitation markers in guilt (V05 p-004 ¶318; V12 p-006 ¶400) and compressed exclamations in combat or excitement (V05 p-005 ¶404; V14 p-008 ¶281, ¶286). Many controls carry his verbatim lines with their own row. C would understate a located morphology, address set and state deltas. A is rejected: there is no frequency or distribution data, address toward Theo (Theoto Rikka), Grethe (Grethe Wenzel) and Vika (Viktor Idinarohk) is not given, Nina is addressed only as チビ in one V03 row (p-005 ¶207), and the L09 voice ledger is outside the set.

Ordinary conduct of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) is located but mostly episodic: hot sausage at breakfast (V07 p-007 ¶72-73), the central-Federacy home dish of salted cabbage with sausage or salted pork (V14 p-007 ¶472), the cat plush for Nina (V07 p-007 ¶453-465), fishing with Rito (Rito Oriya) and Fido (V08 p-005 ¶243), watching chess (Alter.1 part0041 ¶5), the deadpan 幽霊 Halloween costume (V12 p-008 ¶655), siphoning petrol (V14 p-004 ¶309), birthday-gift culture (Alter.1 part0053 ¶3) and being dragged into sparring (V13 p-005 ¶258-260). The embarrassment pattern is well sampled (V05 p-006 ¶239-241; V07 p-006 ¶86; V09 p-006 ¶191; Alter.1 part0044 ¶19-34) and the care pattern of continuing to show up is stated. B would overclaim: most leisure and food items are single narrator mentions without his speech or a stated driver, the profile gives no routine, and Alter.1 rows have no volume placement. D would understate a recurring embarrassment and care pattern with located instances across the corpus.

The profile conditions Marcel (Erwin Marcel)'s conduct by partner and phase. Shin (Shinei Nouzen): hostile projection (V02-V03), direct apology without asking for comfort (V05 p-004 ¶318), ordinary peer joking and the shared gift (V07 p-007 ¶72-73, ¶448-465), reciprocal moral peer who receives Shin's dangerous feeling without moralizing (V11 p-026 ¶544-557) and deidealization (V12 p-006 ¶401-402). Nina: older-brother-like stewardship rooted in Eugene but sustained in its own right, from the V03 gate (p-005 ¶202-232) to マルセルお兄ちゃん (V13 p-004 ¶77) and panic for her safety (V14 p-004 ¶182-183). Lena (Vladilena Milizé): formal 大佐 with comic self-preservation, then first-name tacit coordination (V11 p-018 ¶361-370) and privacy protection (Alter.1 part0044 ¶19). Theo (Theoto Rikka): equality-rich banter in the adapted vehicle (V14 p-008 ¶62-79). Vika (Viktor Idinarohk): intimidated familiarity (V08 p-006 ¶166-171). Hjerna and other unfamiliar peers: politer 〜っす without elegance. C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: Rito (Rito Oriya), Grethe (Grethe Wenzel) and the wider cohort rest on few rows, Eugene appears only in memory, and the L02 relationship ledger is outside the set.

Private states of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) are narrated at a few located points: the V03 gate scene, where narration gives the shift from grief to moral transfer and his recognition of how persecution works, with a smile whose malice he cannot see (p-005 ¶216-263); V05, where he thinks he always found Shin's (Shinei Nouzen) flatness hard to bear (p-004 ¶313); and V12, where narration links the obedience remark to his own past and states his wish to carry at least his own fear and pain (p-006 ¶395-402). V14 narrates his panic over Nina (p-004 ¶183). These states drive located conduct. B would overclaim: interior access is confined to these scenes, V06-V11 interior is inferred from speech and face, and V11 is narrated from Shin's side. D would understate explicit narrated interiority causally tied to his apology and his V12 self-standard.

The profile states a conflict pattern for Marcel (Erwin Marcel): anger sharpens speech and narrows causal judgment, which is where the early version is most dangerous; rough speech and shouted retorts can coexist with trust and should not be read as fracture (V14 p-008 ¶67-79); the mature response to having blamed someone unfairly is discomfort before eloquence, then naming his own act. Serious interpersonal conflict is located only in V02-V03 (V02 p-004 ¶373-380; V03 p-005 ¶258-263) and its V05 repair; later conflict is banter or intimidation (V08 p-006 ¶166-171). B would overclaim: his conduct under a fresh, serious grievance after V05 is the profile's open question and is not sampled. D would understate an explicit pattern with its located failure case and correction.

Moral reasoning is the center of the profile for Marcel (Erwin Marcel), and it is located: the V02 accusation rebuked by his superior as sinking to the Republic's level (p-004 ¶373-384); V03 recognition of the scapegoating mechanism from inside it (p-005 ¶258); V05 apology in which grief explains but does not absolve (p-004 ¶318); V11 distinguishing Shin's (Shinei Nouzen) actual claim from its ugliest reading and answering from shared grief (p-026 ¶544-557); and V12 nonthought as responsibility anesthesia and his self-standard (p-006 ¶393-402, ¶408). It bounds guilt as specific rather than global and accountability as not requiring endless punishment. C would understate a causally ordered ethical account with a stated failure mode and its correction. A is rejected: the profile frames V12 maturity as a continuing question rather than a settled disposition, and no repeat of the original wound tests it.

The profile gives Marcel (Erwin Marcel) a distinct comic fingerprint: minimal setup, deadpan stupidity and willingness to look ridiculous (the 幽霊 forehead, V12 p-008 ¶655), defensive embarrassment jokes (V05 p-006 ¶241), teasing Shin (Shinei Nouzen) about his romance (V07 p-007 ¶73), loud protest with willing participation (V14 p-008 ¶67-70), the hedgehog-mark exchange (p-008 ¶77-79) and exhilarated laughter after a successful shot (p-008 ¶286-289), plus suppressed laughter in the control room (V12 p-007 ¶518-521). It warns against removing either his comedy or his seriousness. C would understate a located, stated comic style that predicts register in ordinary and combat settings. A is rejected: there is no account of humor under grief or toward unfamiliar people, and several comic items are narrator mentions.

The profile prints its full scene bank for Marcel (Erwin Marcel): 198 rows, each routed to an exact XHTML paragraph with a Japanese anchor, across V02-V14 and Alter.1 (V02 5, V03 10, V04 3, V05 24, V06 4, V07 23, V08 13, V09 16, V11 24, V12 26, V13 11, V14 33, Alter.1 6). Only V10 has no row. C would understate paragraph-level routing that reaches every developmental state the profile names. A is rejected: six rows reuse Phase-5 locator authority and 192 carry LOCATOR_GAP status, many rows are narrator mentions of him in a group, the profile defers to the L01, L02 and L09 ledgers and the Phase-5 and Phase-8 authorities outside the set, and the set is one derived artifact.

The profile affirmatively bounds Marcel (Erwin Marcel): the right-leg nerve injury permanently rules out high-speed mobile piloting inside the boundary while leaving walking and running (V05 p-004 ¶309; V09 p-010 ¶213), and the V14 platform exists because of it (p-008 ¶59); he is not a strategic genius; he admits partial understanding (V12 p-006 ¶354); the apology does not erase the earlier harm; grief does not excuse the racialized accusation; and a twelve-item counterexample audit plus mischaracterization traps and 'would sound wrong if' constraints rule out named misreadings. Postwar vocation, long-term civilian relationships and any higher-mobility role are explicitly open. C would understate located affirmative limits with explicit traps. A is rejected: several bounds are stated without their own row, and the boundary items are open rather than negative.

State changes of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) are located at paragraph level: the injury and hospital scene (V03 p-005 ¶192), the recognition (¶258), the apology (V05 p-004 ¶318), the command-post strike (V05 p-006 ¶474), the address shift to レーナ (V11 p-018 ¶361), the reversed grief scene (V11 p-026 ¶544-557), the self-standard (V12 p-006 ¶393-402) and the adapted gunner role (V14 p-008 ¶58-289). Every row carries its volume and paragraph. C would understate this located sequence. A is rejected: V10 has no row, V06-V09 is grouped, his age and promotion timing are not located, and Alter.1 rows have no volume placement.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation: 俺 as relaxed first person; contractions and colloquial reductions as baseline in every register, including grief and technical talk; 〜っす or standard operational politeness upward; no polished essay-like abstraction.

Address uses only attested forms: ノウゼン for Shin (Shinei Nouzen); 大佐 for Lena (Vladilena Milizé) in formal or early contexts and レーナ in established work talk from V11; チビ for Nina only as in the V03 row. No form toward Theo (Theoto Rikka), Grethe (Grethe Wenzel), Vika (Viktor Idinarohk) or strangers is invented.

State is fixed before register: guilt slows and adds ellipses and self-restarts and names concrete acts; embarrassment averts and adds noise; danger compresses to short exclamations; relief and excitement become loud and youthful; grief shared with a trusted peer is quiet without becoming formal.
No frequency distribution, anime performance or state after V14 is claimed, and output that depends on one abstains.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence constrains morphology, address, upward politeness and state deltas for Marcel (Erwin Marcel) enough for illustrative output with sampled relations. Missing frequency data and unattested address forms limit confidence and are handled by abstention.

conditions: The decisive question in any blame-shaped situation is the selected state: before V05 he may displace responsibility onto a capable other; from V05 he names his own act; from V12 he asks whether he is making someone else carry what he cannot. A new Eugene-scale personal loss is outside the evidence, and output there presents both continuation and relapse as open.
The leg injury is always present: no high-speed mobile piloting; control, mapping, communications, analysis, fixed-fire support or, from V14, the gunner seat of an adapted slow platform.
Visible fear, embarrassment or noisy complaint coexists with action and with trust; neither is read as cowardice or relational fracture.
Transfer to an unfamiliar interlocutor uses the politer 〜っす register and is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected state: V02-V03 grief and displaced blame; V05 after the apology (p-004 ¶318); V06-V09 control officer and ordinary peer; V11-V12 reciprocal moral peer and responsibility self-standard (after p-006 ¶402 in V12); or V14 adapted gunner. Nothing after V14; Alter.1 rows do not fix a state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: A profiled relation in its attested register: Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Nina, Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Theo (Theoto Rikka), Vika (Viktor Idinarohk) or the Spearhead and Strike Package cohort; Rito (Rito Oriya) and Grethe (Grethe Wenzel) only within their sampled rows; an unfamiliar peer such as Hjerna only under the lower-confidence transfer condition.
setting_constraints: Federacy or allied military settings he is shown in: control trailer or command post, mess and lunch table, leave abroad, base social life, or the adapted vehicle.
No postwar civilian life, vocation or family setting beyond the remembered home dish and Nina's household as reported.
No tactical or strategic authority beyond control-officer and gunner roles.

scenario_readiness.note: Located states, partner-specific registers and a stated decisive interrupt support bounded extrapolation for Marcel (Erwin Marcel). The profile's open question about a repeat of the original wound, and the thin sampling of some relations, restrict use rather than lowering the tier.

conditions: Sampled classes only: mess and lunch-table talk, romance gossip about others, gifts for Nina, group bathing or changing embarrassment, holiday and birthday customs, fishing and chess spectating, being dragged into group sparring.
Embarrassment means averted eyes, muttering, defensive jokes or practical privacy management while staying in the room; care is practical and continuing rather than speechified.
No invented hobbies, routine, food hierarchy or civilian social circle beyond attested items.
scenario_readiness.note: Located embarrassment and care patterns support bounded ordinary-social extrapolation for Marcel (Erwin Marcel). Single-mention leisure items and no routine block READY.

conditions: Situation classes the profile samples: who is responsible for a death, displaced grief, obedience and the comfort of not thinking, distinguishing what a grieving peer actually claims from its ugliest reading, and quiet institutional discretion with Lena (Vladilena Milizé).

The selected state decides: V02-V03 may scapegoat; from V05 he names his own act without demanding absolution; from V12 he treats responsibility as including himself and does not idealize Shin (Shinei Nouzen).
Reasoning comes in rough, hesitant speech rather than abstraction; no political or governance judgment outside these classes.
scenario_readiness.note: A located ethical account with its failure mode and correction supports bounded extrapolation for Marcel (Erwin Marcel) in blame and responsibility situations.

The profile records no romantic relationship or interest of Marcel (Erwin Marcel)'s own within the boundary and lists long-term civilian relationship structure as open. His romance-related evidence is embarrassment and gossip about the romance of Shin (Shinei Nouzen) and Lena (Vladilena Milizé), covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and HUMOR_PLAY. Nothing about his own romance is established, so no readiness is claimed either way.

conditions: Roles the profile samples: Vánargand pilot before the injury (reported), control officer reporting and analyzing maps (V04 p-007 ¶100; p-008 ¶206), tactical memory under pressure (V05 p-005 ¶404), emergency physical response (V05 p-006 ¶474), institutional explanation (V09 p-006 ¶190-194), relaying analyzed imagery and timing (V12 p-006 ¶725-731; p-007 ¶353), map data and terrain checks (V13 p-006 ¶483, ¶618), and the V14 gunner role (p-008 ¶103, ¶281-283).
He answers what he knows directly in casual military language and says when he only partly understands; he is neither a helpless desk officer nor a hidden genius.
No command authority, staff planning role or postwar career is modeled, and no high-speed mobile piloting is restored.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled control, analysis and adapted-combat work, including its limits, supports bounded extrapolation for Marcel (Erwin Marcel) within one selected state.

known_limits.statement: The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V02-V14 for Marcel (Erwin Marcel), with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 and the chronology-breaking perfume-battle material excluded. The profile lists his postwar occupation, long-term civilian relationships, any later higher-mobility vehicle role and the final-arc outcome as open.

The profile's forward question is whether Marcel (Erwin Marcel) sustains owned responsibility under a future loss as personally devastating as Eugene's death. The corpus strongly supports the maturation but supplies no repeat test of the original wound, so relapse and continuation both remain possible there.

The right-leg nerve injury of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) is a permanent state inside the boundary: walking and running are possible, but the reaction delay makes high-speed mobile piloting unsafe (V05 p-004 ¶309; V09 p-010 ¶213). The V14 gunner role is adaptation, not recovery (p-008 ¶59).

The scene bank for Marcel (Erwin Marcel) has no V10 row and only three to five rows in V02, V04 and V06; many rows are narrator mentions of him within a group. The profile notes that mentoring younger officers who externalize failure is supported as a mechanism but never shown.

The set is one derived character reference profile. It defers to the Japanese source, the Phase-5 locator and Phase-8 verification layers, and the L01, L02 and L09 ledgers, none of which is curated on this subject; 192 of its 198 rows carry LOCATOR_GAP status with exact routes. Its CMR-9 verdicts and confidence labels are inputs, not conclusions.

Relations of Marcel (Erwin Marcel) with Rito (Rito Oriya), Grethe (Grethe Wenzel), Hjerna and the wider cohort rest on few rows, and Eugene appears only through memory and Nina; extrapolation to those relations is lower-confidence than to Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Nina, Lena (Vladilena Milizé) or Theo (Theoto Rikka).
No held-out validation, probe set or frequency census of speech is part of the curated evidence; generated dialogue is illustrative and its accuracy is untested.
